Container.Name: subgen
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider donating
Container.Overview: Subgen - Bazarr Edition: A Whisper ASR server for generating subtitles via Bazarr's Whisper provider.

Config.Name: Variable: TRANSCRIBE_DEVICE
Config.Description: Device for transcription: cpu, cuda, or gpu

Config.Name: Variable: WHISPER_MODEL
Config.Description: Model size: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v1, large-v2, large-v3, large-v3-turbo, distil-large-v2, distil-large-v3

Config.Name: Variable: WHISPER_THREADS
Config.Description: Number of CPU threads for computation

Config.Name: Variable: MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Directory to store Whisper models inside container

Config.Name: Variable: TEMP_FILE_PATH
Config.Description: Directory for temporary files during upload (large files >1MB spill here)

Config.Name: Variable: COMPUTE_TYPE
Config.Description: CTranslate2 quantization type (auto, int8, float16, etc.)

Config.Name: Variable: CLEAR_VRAM_ON_COMPLETE
Config.Description: Free GPU memory when transcription queue is empty

Config.Name: Variable: APPEND
Config.Description: Add credit line to generated subtitles

Config.Name: Variable: FORCE_DETECTED_LANGUAGE_TO
Config.Description: Override detected language (2-letter code, e.g., en, fr)

Config.Name: Variable: DETECT_LANGUAGE_LENGTH
Config.Description: Seconds of audio to analyze for language detection

Config.Name: Variable: DETECT_LANGUAGE_OFFSET
Config.Description: Start offset for language detection (skip intros)

Config.Name: Variable: SUBGEN_KWARGS
Config.Description: Additional kwargs for Whisper model (advanced, Python dict format)
